newsitem.title: CHINA: PEREGRINE UPS CHINA, HONG KONG WEIGHTINGS.
newsitem.headline: PEREGRINE UPS CHINA, HONG KONG WEIGHTINGS.

text.p: Peregrine Asset Management said on Thursday that it has increased its weighting in Hong Kong and China, mostly at the expense of Malaysia and South Korea.
The Hong Kong weighting has been raised to 39 percent from 36 percent in July, compared with a Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) Far East Free ex-Japan weighting of 35 percent.
Peregrine's China weighting has risen to six percent from four percent in July, compared with 0.9 percent in the MSCI Far East Free ex-Japan weighting.
The weighting in Malaysia has been cut to eight percent from 10.5 percent compared with the MSCI average of 16.8 percent.
Peregrine's South Korean weighting has dropped to three pecent from five percent against 5.6 percent in the MSCI.

Indonesia has also been cut to nine percent from 10 percent against the MSCI average of 7.4 percent, while the Philippines has dropped to five percent from six percent against the MSCI average of 3.2 percent.

Singapore has fallen to 11 percent from 11.5 percent for a neutral position against the MSCI average, while Peregrine's Taiwan weighting has jumped two percentage points to 14 percent from 12 percent against an MSCI average of 15.1 percent.
Thailand is unchanged and neutral against the MSCI at five percent.
